author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m using a SharkBite slip coupling to repair these copper pipes. This fitting is fantastic if the copper pipes don’t move horizontally or vertically. The slip end can slide up to 2 inches and that allows the new copper pipe section to be installed using disconnect tongs. Each copper pipe should be deburred and cleaned for a proper watertight connection. But I’ve used these slip couplings for years on copper pipes without any issues
